## Resources

Papers referenced throughout the workshop materials:

**Workshop dataset**

- [Wei et al. (2025)](https://www.cell.com/immunity/fulltext/S1074-7613(25)00331-0), _Immunity_: Transcription factor BACH2 shapes tissue-resident memory T cell programs to promote HIV-1 persistence

**Multiomics protocols**

- [Stoeckius et al. (2017)](https://www.nature.com/articles/nmeth.4380), _Nature Methods_: Simultaneous epitope and transcriptome measurement in single cells
- [Stoeckius et al. (2018)](https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-018-1603-1), _Genome Biology_: Cell Hashing with barcoded antibodies enables multiplexing and doublet detection for single cell genomics
- [Mimitou et al. (2021)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-021-00927-2), _Nature Biotechnology_: Scalable, multimodal profiling of chromatin accessibility, gene expression and protein levels in single cells
- [Swanson et al. (2021)](https://elifesciences.org/articles/63632), _eLife_: Simultaneous trimodal single-cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq

**Experimental considerations**

- [Kim et al. (2024)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/chapter/bookseries/pii/S1937644824001187), _International Review of Cell and Molecular Biology_: DOGMA-seq and multimodal, single-cell analysis in acute myeloid leukemia
- [Bakken et al. (2018)](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0209648), _PLOS ONE_: Single-nucleus and single-cell transcriptomes compared in matched cortical cell types
- [Buus et al. (2021)](https://elifesciences.org/articles/61973), _eLife_: Improving oligo-conjugated antibody signal in multimodal single-cell analysis
- [Mulè et al. (2022)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-022-29356-8), _Nature Communications_: Normalizing and denoising protein expression data from droplet-based single cell profiling

**Analysis methods**

- [Heumos et al. (2023)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41576-023-00586-w), _Nature Reviews Genetics_: Best practices for single-cell analysis across modalities
- [Korsunsky et al. (2019)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-019-0619-0), _Nature Methods_: Fast, sensitive and accurate integration of single-cell data with Harmony
- [Traag et al. (2019)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-019-41695-z), _Scientific Reports_: From Louvain to Leiden: guaranteeing well-connected communities
